stats.done_summary: Successfully completed flame speed vs. chamber pressure analysis. Identified clear two-regime combustion behavior with transition at 82.40 kPa. Regime 1 (38.0-81.5 kPa) follows power law S = 1178.98P^{-0.930} with R²=0.9991. Regime 2 (82.4-97.5 kPa) follows linear model S = -0.1632P + 46.0559 with R²=0.9452. Generated comprehensive report with methodology, results, figures, and discussion. All deliverables created: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and publication-quality report in report/report.md with figures in report/images/.
